items.question: When is check-in and check-out?
items.answer: Check-in is welcome anytime between 3:00 PM and 8:00 PM. Check-out is by 11:00 AM so we can freshly bake Malabar puttu and prepare rooms for the next incoming guests.

items.question: Are pets allowed?
items.answer: Yes! We love pets. Dogs are highly welcome at Greeda’s Grange (especially in Room 4 as it has direct garden lawn access). We only ask that you keep them off the linen beds and respect our resident wildlife.

items.question: Can you cater to dietary restrictions?
items.answer: Absolutely. Greeda can prepare gluten-free rice puttu, dairy-free spreads, and custom vegan platters. Please mention any allergies or dietary preferences in your booking special requests!
